# Launch: the landing page is indexable; the admin portal and event share pages are not.
# Do not edit apps/landing/robots.txt by hand; run scripts/set-indexing.sh on|off.
User-agent: *
Allow: /
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /e/

# Link-preview crawlers (Slack, X, LinkedIn and others honor robots.txt when they unfurl a pasted link) may read every
# public page, including event share pages, so links show a title, description and image. They never index anything:
# /e/ pages send X-Robots-Tag noindex. A crawler obeys only its most specific group, so this group repeats the Disallows.
User-agent: Twitterbot
User-agent: LinkedInBot
User-agent: Slackbot-LinkExpanding
User-agent: Slackbot
User-agent: Discordbot
User-agent: facebookexternalhit
User-agent: Facebot
User-agent: TelegramBot
Allow: /
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /u/
Disallow: /o/

Sitemap: https://letsdip.work/sitemap.xml
